notes.title: Reworks and Balancing - v1.2.313
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

I'm supper happy to announce the latest reworks/balancing changes are live on the main branch!

To help you guys understand what have been changed here is a list of the most important changes (didn't add everything, just the most important changes, but all the changes were added to the patch notes of the beta versions)

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Temporarily removed Sage's Card Star Blessing due to it causing many bugs.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buffed almost all Epic Die.
[*] Buffed all Epic Die Purify 3 to Purify 6.
[*] Buffed almost all Neutral Die and removed dice that were feeling unnecessary.
[*] Decreased Forge Action low tier cost from 100 to 50.
[*] Buffed Cryptic Memento, changed it from a Black Hole Blessing to a Star Blessing and removed the Obscure drawback. Also decreased from 4 to 3 Max Corruption increase.
[*] Buffed Perpetual Clock, now it makes Mandatory actions not needed to be used to end player turn. Corruption dealt to player is not increased by any Corruption modifier.
[*] Buffed Brightful Stone, now it ignores Hollow Skin when applying Safeguard.
[*] Buffed Apprentice's Card, decreased from 6 to 4 Starter Die and increased Purification received by all targets from 6 to 10.
[*] Buffed Photon Glove, increased Purification dealt by Starter Die from 1 to 2.
[*] Removed Forge Area Purify Epic Die and Risky Die. Buffed Forge Area Purify Balanced Die values.
[*] Changed Forge Purify Balanced Die to Safe Die with all die faces as Forge Purify.
[*] Changed Inner Peace Balanced Die to Safe Die with all die faces as Player Serenity.
[*] Buffed Light Shield dice values. Buffed Safe Die and Epic Die, added Draw 1 to 3 die faces. Buffed Balanced Die, added Draw 1 to 2 die faces.
[*] Removed High Guard die.
[*] Buffed Purify dice values. Buffed Safe Die and Epic Die, added Draw 1 to 3 die faces. Buffed Balanced Die, added Draw 1 to 2 die faces.
[*] Removed Quick Strike die.
[*] Removed Defensive Light Risky Die. Buffed Balanced Die and Epic Die values.
[*] Removed Meditate Balanced Die. Buffed Safe Die values.
[*] Added Reroll Epic Die. Buffed Reroll Safe Die.
[*] Buffed Serenity dice values. Buffed Epic Die, now all die faces are Serenity and added Draw 1 to 2 Serenity 1 die faces.
[/list]
[b]Moonie[/b] :moonie:
[list]
[*] Buffed Minor Reroll Starter Die, added another Reroll 1 + Player Purify 1 die face.
[*] Buffed Twilight Sigil dice values.
[*] Buffed Eclipse Gaze dice values. Removed Balanced Die and Safe Die, added Risky Die. Increased Serenity from 1 to 2.
[*] Buffed Lunar Alignment, now it affects dice from all targets.
[*] Buffed Knowledge Outburst, now it affects dice from all targets.
[/list]
[b]Cellarius[/b] :cellarius:
[list]
[*] Buffed Coral Crown, increased Hammerhead Will from 1 to 3.
[*] Buffed Denticle Suit, now it also increases Light Shield apply by 1.
[*] Buffed Runic Oar, now it also makes Twin Smash deal Purification 1 additional time.
[*] Buffed Jellyfish Bell, now Empower decrease can be negated by Protection.
[*] Changed many dice bad faces from Player Self Corrupt to Corrupt.
[*] Removed Geyser Uppercut Safe Die. Nerfed Balanced Die, added 2 Unforgeable Corrupt die faces.
[*] Buffed Sunken Curse, now it can be negated by Protection and buffed dice values.
[*] Reworked Forceful Stream, removed Wave additional Purification. Buffed Forceful Stream dice values. Buffed Epic Die, added Draw 1 to 2 die faces. Also Corruption received from it can't be increased anymore.
[*] Buffed Empower dice values.
[*] Buffed Hammerhead Will dice values and removed Dissolve Life die face.
[*] Buffed High Hammerhead Will dice values and added another Hammerhead Will 3 die face.
[*] Buffed Sharpen Fin, decreased Sharpen Fin amount to gain 1 Empower from 3 to 2.
[*] Buffed Indigo Rite, changed Balanced Die to a Safe Die and all die faces are Indigo Rite.
[*] Removed Invigorating Punch Risky Die and Epic Die. Buffed Balanced Die values.
[*] Buffed Shark Onslaught Risky Die, removed Dissolve Life die face and changed bad faces to Corrupt.
[*] Buffed Shark Payback Risky Die, removed Dissolve Life die face and decreased bad die faces Corrupt amount.
[*] Buffed Shark Rush, now the Corruption dealt is not increased by any Corruption modifier.
[/list]
[b]Hevelius[/b] :hevelius:
[list]
[*] Buffed Glowing Reactor, now also whenever Incorruptible is applied, player gains 5 Light Shield. Also whenever Barrier is applied, player gains 2 Light Shield.
[*] Reworked Shining Apparatus, now whenever a sentinel receives Corruption or Breaks, it applies X Radiant Bomb to that sentinel, where X is half of that sentinel Max Corruption (rounded up) instead of applying Radiant Bomb at the start of the battle equal the sentinel Max Corruption.
[*] Buffed Bright Resonator, now also at the end of player turn the enemy with least Corruption receives 1 Purification for each Light Shield player has.
[*] Removed Forge Light Shield die.
[*] Added Forge Barrier Balanced Die.
[*] Buffed Augmented Welding, now when applied a random enemy receives X Purification, where X is half of this sentinel Max Corruption.
[*] Buffed Mechanical Domination, now the die changed to Area Corrupt 1 won't be affected by doom until the end of enemies turn.
[/list]
[b]Austra[/b] :austra:
[list]
[*] Buffed Vacuum Wings, increased from 40 to 90 Dodge and decreases Dodge by double the amount of Corruption dodged.
[*] Buffed Apian Drone, now it also applies 50 Dodge to all sentinels at the start of each battle, increased Dodge decrease from 5 to 10 and now it also applies 1 Boost on player if the sentinel Dodges Corruption during enemies turn.
[*] Reworked Drifter Catcher, now it also applies 25 Dodge to all enemies at the start of each battle, the enemy doesn't lose all Dodge and decreased Purification from 45 to 20.
[*] Buffed Frantic Firefly, now it apply Confuse Multiplier to player if player already have 50 Brilliance.
[*] Buffed Auspicious Dandelion, now it applies 1 Eolic Divination to player every 2 turns instead of at the start of the battle.
[*] Buffed Indomitable Fan, now also whenever an enemy gets overcorrupted, player gains 1 Critical Multiplier.
[*] Buffed Dodge dice values. Add Draw 1 to many die faces.
[*] Buffed Critical dice values. Buffed Safe Die, now all die faces are Purify + Critical. Buffed Balanced Die, added Draw 1 to 2 Critical 8 die faces. Buffed Epic Die values and added Draw 1 to 3 Critical 10 die faces.
[*] Buffed Critical Multiplier. Changed from Risky Die to Balanced Die. Buffed Epic Die, now all die faces are Critical Multiplier and added Draw 1 to 2 Critical Multiplier 1 die faces.
[*] Buffed Glimmering Breeze die values and now it can be negated by Protection and buffed dice values.
[*] Removed Dancing Wings Balanced Die.
[/list]
[b]Sothis[/b] :sothis:
[list]
[*] Reworked Behenian Hourglass, now instead of applying Sands of Time at the start of the battle it applies 1 Hourglass Mastery every 2 turns.
[*] Changed Sands of Time 10 Virtue to Hourglass Mastery 1.
[*] Changed Hourglass Mastery description to not depend on Sands of Time.
[*] Changed Rewind Chanting description to not depend on Sands of Time.
[*] Improved Sands of Time description.
[*] Buffed Reroll 2 Virtue to 3.
[*] Buffed Minor Relief Starter Die values.
[*] Removed Minor Shield Starter Die.
[*] Added 2 Minor Sandshaping Starter Die to starting dice pool. Minor Sandshaping die faces: 1 x Sandshaping 3, 2 x Sandshaping 2, 2 x Sandshaping 1, 1 x Corrupt 3.
[*] Added 1 Minor Stasis Starter Die to starting dice pool. Minor Stasis die faces: 2 x Calm 1, 2 x Timeless 1, 2 x Light Shield 1.
[*] Buffed Scorching Sands, now it deals 2 additional Purification on top of the Purification based on Soul Heat.
[*] Buffed Singing Urn, increased Purification received for each Chanting from 2 to 4 and now it adds 1 Chanting Safe Die into player's Draw Pool at the start of each battle.
[*] Buffed Resonant Ankh, increased Chanting gain from 2 to 3.
[*] Buffed Contemplation Sarcophagus, now player also gains 1 Inner Warmth every turn.
[*] Buffefd Balance of Reckoning, changed from all enemies to all targets, increased Relief from 3 to 4 and now when ending the turn on even Soul Heat (Affliction) also gain 2 Boost. Also swapped the effects, now Affliction + Boost are applied on even Soul Heat and Relief is applied on odd Soul Heat.
[*] Reworked Goddess Cartouche, changed it from a Black Hole Blessing to a Star Blessing and removed the Sentinel Torment drawback.
[*] Changed Tainted Khepresh name to Regal Khepresh. Buffed Regal Khepresh, changed it from a Black Hole Blessing to a Star Blessing, removed the Affliction drawback and now it also increase Relief applied by 1.
[*] Buffed Ghostly Lamp, now sentinels also trigger it.
[*] Buffed Solace Crook, now sentinels also trigger it.
[*] Buffed Hourglass Module, now it also applies 10 Dodge to player at the start of each battle.
[*] Buffed Bloody Solstice, now it doubles all effects applied by the player.
[*] Buffed Sands of Time, now it triggers Rolling Stars and Arcanist's Orrery.
[*] Removed Inner Warmth Risky Die.
[*] Buffed Concentration dice values, added Draw 1 to all Concentration die faces and Boost 1 to 2 Concentration 1 die faces on Epic Die.
[*] Buffed Distortion Hieroglyph dice values. Added a Distortion Hieroglyph 2 die face to Balanced Die. Now the Epic Die has Distortion Hieroglyph in all its die faces and added Draw 1 to 2 Distortion Hieroglyph 1 die faces.
[*] Buffed Fire Breath dice values. Added Draw 1 and Boost 1 to many die faces.
[*] Buffed Glass Daggers dice values.
[*] Buffed Sunny Flares dice values.
[*] Buffed Inner Warmth dice values. Added 2 Inner Warmth 1 die faces to Balanced. Epic Die now have all its die faces as Inner Warmth. Added Added Draw 1 to 2 Inner Warmth 1 die faces on Epic Die and Balanced Die and decreased bad die faces Corrupt amount from Balanced Die and Risky Die.
[*] Buffed Spinning Chanting, changed Risky Die to Balanced Die and added another Spinning Chanting die face. Now all the die faces are Spinning Chanting on Epic Die.
[*] Nerfed Refreshing Mantra, now it decreases Soult Heat by 4 when Refreshing Virtues.
[/list]
[b]Orion[/b] :orionastrea:
[list]
[*] Buffed Orbital Renovation, added another Draw 1 to Revolution 1 die face, decreased bad die faces Corrupt amount and added 2 Unforgeable Corrupt die faces. Added Orbital Renovation Epic Die.
[*] Removed Redemption Inscription Epic Die. Changed Redemption Inscription Balanced Die to Safe Die, now all die faces are Redemption Inscription.
[*] Removed Retrograde Epic Die.
[*] Buffed Reversal Renovation, added another Draw 1 to Revolution 1 die face, decreased bad die faces Corrupt amount and added 2 Unforgeable Corrupt die faces. Added Reversal Renovation Epic Die.
[/list]
[b]Anomalies[/b]
[b]Reworked Anomaly Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*] Anomaly 4 (Every 3 turns, apply Shadow Mantle to all targets)  moved up 2 Anomaly and is now Anomaly 6.
[*] Added new Anomaly 4, at the start of each battle, add 1 Wound Hex Die into your draw pool.
[*] Anomaly 6 (Increase non-Bosses' Max Corruption) moved up 1 Anomaly and is now Anomaly 7.
[*] Anomaly 7 (Increase Bosses Max Corruption) moved up 1 Anomaly and is now Anomaly 8.
[*] Anomaly 10 (Every 2 turns, apply Ruin to all enemies) was replaced by Anomaly 8 (Enemies abilities are even harder).
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Stunned, now player next X Reroll actions will only reroll 1 die.
[*] At the start of draw phase, Ruin and Nefarious Pulse now triggers before Light Shield and Incorruptible is removed and Barrier is decreased, which means it can be blocked by them.
[*] Nerfed Lost Sentinel Tainted Reef Normal Battle Anomaly 3 and 10. Decreased Agony from 2 to 1 on both Anomalies and increased die faces.
[*] Nerfed Ostreons Tainted Reef Hard Battle all Anomalies. Increased all Ostreons Max Overcorruption by 1.
[*] Nerfed Sanctuary Parasite Tainted Reef Boss Battle Anomaly 10. Increased Vengeful Stab from 4 to 5.
[*] Buffed Doomed Astronomer Astropolis Ruins Boss Battle all Anomalies. Increased base Max Corruption from 110 to 130. Nerfed Doomed Astronomer, now Eldritch Influence only triggers when player plays a non-Mandatory Virtue.
[*] Reworked Profaned Tomb Ground Zero Normal Battle all Anomalies. Added starting Decay 1 and changed 1 Player Torment die face to Area Corrupt.
[*] Reworked and nerfed Voidsmith Ground Zero Hard Battle all Anomalies. Anomaly 3 and Anomaly 10 nerfed, changed Overcorruption from Player Corrupt to Area Purify 6. All anomalies reworked, now Aphotic Instinct starts the battle applying less Doom and the Doom amount applied increases every turn. Anomaly 10 nerfed, decreases Player Corrupt 0 + Paralyzed 3 to Player Corrupt 0 + Paralyzed 2.
[/list]

Now the actual patch notes for this specific update (not translated)
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added localization for all the reworked mechanics.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Moonie[/b]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Haunted Chalk, decreased Purification from 150 to 120.
[/list]
[b]Sothis[/b]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Balance of Reckoning, decreased Relief from 6 to 4.
[*] Nerfed Singing Urn, decreased Purification from 8 to 4.
[*] Nerfed Resonant Ankh, decreased Chanting from 4 to 3.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Contemplation Sarcophagus not appearing as discovered when player already discovered it.
[*] Fixed Bottled Aurora decreasing Stunned when triggered.
[*] Fixed Stunned affecting sentinels.
[*] Fixed Stellar Heritage + The Chosen Pool making player able to choose chest nodes and gain dice during the run.
[*] Fixed Spectral Harvester + Stained Recharging softlock/dice getting stuck.
[*] Fixed Cleromancy applying Light Shield to sentinel instead of the player when a sentinel play it.
[*] Fixed game crashing when enemy receive Purification with Drifter Catcher + Syzygy Star + 100% Dodge active.
[*] Fixed modded Timeless keyword not working in battle.
[/list]

May Astrea bless you 💙 ❤️
- Leonardo Castanho, community manager and lead dev of Astrea

notes.title: Beta Test Reworks and Balancing - v1.2.287
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

A small beta patch focusing on fine tuning and bug fixes. Soon the changes will enter the main branch.

[b]Important Note: All new text are currently only available in English. All of the changes in the beta version are subject to change.[/b]

[b]To access Astrea beta version:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right-click Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles in your Steam Library
[*] Select Properties...
[*] Select the Betas tab
[*] Click the Beta Participation dropdown and select the "beta" branch
[/list]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Temporarily removed Sage's Card Star Blessing due to it causing many bugs.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Moonie[/b]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Eclipse Gaze, decreased Serenity from 3 to 2.
[/list]
[b]Austra[/b]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Apian Lamp, removed start of the battle Favorable Winds.
[/list]
[b]Sothis[/b]
[list]
[*] If player owns Contemplation Sarcophagus dice related to Inner Warmth won't appear anymore.
[*] If player owns Contemplation Sarcophagus and doesn't own Fervorous Sundial dice related to Concentration won't appear anymore.
[*] Reworked Balance of Reckoning, swapped the effects, now Affliction + Boost are applied on even Soul Heat and Relief is applied on odd Soul Heat.
[*] Reworked Goddess Cartouche, changed it from a Black Hole Blessing to a Star Blessing and removed the Sentinel Torment drawback. Also decreased Relief applied from 3 to 1.
[*] Buffed Scorching Sands, now it deals 2 additional Purification on top of the Purification based on Soul Heat.
[*] Nerfed Hourglass Mastery Epic Die, Changed 3 Hourglass Mastery 1 die faces to Purify 6.
[*] Buffed Eclipse Blast dice, added Draw 1 to die faces.
[*] Buffed Sandshaping dice values and added 1 additional Draw 1 to die face.
[*] Buffed Sunny Flares dice values.
[*] Reworked Bloody Solstice so it doesnt double itself when applying it while it is active.
[*] Removed Inner Warmth Risky Die.
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Buffed Doomed Astronomer Astropolis Ruins Boss Battle all Anomalies. Increased base Max Corruption from 110 to 130.
[*] Buffed Voidsmith Ground Zero Hard Battle all Anomalies. Increased starting amount of Doom and Doom gained each turn. Changed Aphotic Instinct value to be the next turn doom amount for clearer feedback.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Test Reworks and Balancing - v1.2.258
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

Another beta patch with balancing/reworks. This time focusing on :cellarius: Cellarius Starting dice, :Austra: Austra blessings, a [b]big change[/b] to :Sothis: Sothis Starting dice, Starting Blessing, Virtues and blessings, a few balancings for :orionastrea: Orion and some balancings for enemies that we felt were too punishing on Anomaly 10.

This will be a small beta period, so in the next couple of weeks the changes that were tested and approved will enter the main branch.

[b]Important Note: All new text are currently only available in English. All of the changes in the beta version are subject to change.[/b]

[b]To access Astrea beta version:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right-click Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles in your Steam Library
[*] Select Properties...
[*] Select the Betas tab
[*] Click the Beta Participation dropdown and select the "beta" branch
[/list]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Neutral[/b]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Bottled Void, increased Stunned from 2 to 3.
[*] Reworked Calm die, changed Purify 1 to Light Shield 1.
[/list]
[b]Moonie[/b]

[*] Buffed Knowledge Outburst, now it affects dice from all targets.
[*] Buffed Twilight Sigil dice values.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Test Reworks and Balancing - v1.2.205
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

Once again we are are working on reworks and balance for all mechanics that are feeling a bit off, we want to make Astrea as much polished as possible. ✨🎲✨
We feel that [b]Neutral dice and Epic Die are specially too weak and need a buff[/b] and also some dice and blessings from Oracles could receive a boost.
Also we feel [b]anomaly levels could still be improved[/b], so we made some changes to it, please let us know what you think.

In this first beta patch we focused on reworking/balancing out dice/blessings from Neutral, Sentinels, Moonie :Moonie:, Cellarius :Cellarius:,  Hevelius :Hevelius: and Austra :Austra:.
Hope you all have fun testing out the reworks/interactions.

We will make a small beta period to test out those changes and our community feedback will be very much appreciated. Therefore this patch has been uploaded to our beta branch.

notes.title: Reworks and Balancing - v1.1.565
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

The last months we've been working on reworks and balancing for each oracle :moonie: :cellarius: :hevelius: :austra: :sothis: :orionastrea: and all other mechanics that were feeling a bit off on the beta branch. To make the game as much polished as possible. ✨🎲✨

The reworks ended a while ago, but we couldn't put live on the main branch, because we were localizing all the changes and making sure that all the changes were stable. Alongside we were working (and still working) on a new major update (v1.2 😱😱😱). So that is the reason why it took sometime to the reworks/balancing move to the main branch.

But now I'm supper happy to announce the reworks/balancing changes are live on the main branch!

To help you guys understand what have been changed here is a list of the most important changes (didn't add everything, just the most important changes, but all the changes were added to the patch notes of the beta versions):

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now it is possible to skip destroy die and forge die rewards/events.
[*] Now it is possible to go back to previous screen when forging, duplicating or destroying a die on shop/events.
[*] Now it is possible to go back to previous screen when on choose/change one of your current sentinels screen.
[*] Now pressing "Esc" when inspecting a die, viewing draw pool, discard, dice pool and etc (all UI that player can go back) will go back to previous screen instead of opening the Pause Menu.
[*] Now pressing mouse right-click while dragging a die or a Virtue will drop the current dragged item.
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts for End Turn, Draw Pool, Discard, Dice Pool, Corruption Meter and Hearts, Sentinels and map UI.
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts for selecting Dice and Virtues.
[*] Added key binding menu.
[*] Removed Fast Purification score.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new mute system based on chapter where some dice and blessings won't appear on certain chapters. Dice and Blessings that appear only on certain chapters have a "C" letter with a number beside the name of the Blessing and beside the owner of the die, this represents in which chapter that Blessing or Die can appear. For instance, C1C2 means it can appear only on Tainted Reef or Astropolis Ruins. If there is no "C", it means it can appear in any chapter.
[*] Now dice rewards won't ever have 3 Neutral dice at once.

notes.title: Beta Test Reworks and Balancing - v1.1.505
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

Last batch of big reworks/balancing! (there could be another smaller one before sending the changes with the main branch though)
In this beta patch we focused on reworking/balancing out actions/mechanics from [b]Sothis :sothis: and Orion :orionastrea:[/b] again, because we felt there were more room for improvements (specially Sothis).
Also we decided to buff some Events and balanced some enemies.
And we wanted to try out improving the map. We felt that some parts of the map weren't giving really meaningful choices to the player, so we tried reorganizing the map to try make it more consistent and make the choices more meaningful.

[b]Important Note: All new actions currently have temporary icons/names and all of the new text is currently only available in English. All of the changes in the beta version are subject to change.[/b]

[b]To access Astrea beta version:[/b]

[list]

[*] Renamed Overloaded Repair to Enduring Repair.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Nerfed Brilliance Safe Die, changed 2 die faces from Purify + Brilliance to Unforgeable Purify + Brilliance.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Buffed Fervorous Sundial, now it applies 1 Relief to a random target when Soul Heat is above 10 and is increased.

[*] Nerfed Astral Mantra, now it decreases Soul Heat by 2 when equal or above the required Soul Heat.

[/list]

[list]
[*] Nerfed Comet Convergence dice values.
[*] Buffed Supernova Pact dice values.
[*] Nerfed Alchemical Revelation, now it decreases Astrium by 3 instead of 2.
[*] Buffed Catalyst Convergence, now player also gain 1 Astrium.
[*] Buffed Volatile Reaction, now player also gain 1 Astrium.
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Fallen Hermit Tainted Reef Hard Battle buffed, increased Max Corruption from 30 to 45.
[*] Doomed Astronomer Astropolis Ruins Boss Battle reworked, now Armillary Rejector and Armillary Negator start with Eldritch Connection effect, that makes Doomed Astronomer receive half Purification of every Purification received by them.
[*] Tormented Seer Ground Zero Normal Battle nerfed on all anomalies. Anomaly 0 changed an Area Corrupt 3 die face to Player Corrupt 3. Anomaly 3 increased Over Corruption from 7 to 8, decreased Meteor Rain die face from 5 to 4. Anomaly 8 increased Over Corruption from 6 to 7, decreased Meteor Rain die face from 6 to 5.
[*] Shady Sculpture and Misty Urchiriuns Ground Zero Normal Battle changed to be a Hard Battle. Increasead Shady Sculpture Max Corruption from 80-90 to 100-110.
[*] All Hard Battle enemies on Ground Zero, but Voidsmith, now have their Max Corruption increased on the second Hard Battle of Ground Zero.
[*] Corrupted Moonie Astrea's Heart Boss Battle all Astrea nerfed. Astrea 1 decreased 1 die face Wound Hex 2 to Wound Hex 1, decreased Dusky Conversion from 3 to 2 and decreased Corrupted Enhance 2 + Corrupted Knowledge 2 die face to Corrupted Enhance 1 + Corrupted Knowledge 1. Astrea 3 decreased 2 die faces Wound Hex 3 to Wound Hex 2, decreased Dusky Conversion from 4 to 3 and decreased Corrupted Enhance 3 + Corrupted Knowledge 3 die face to Corrupted Enhance 2 + Corrupted Knowledge 2.
[/list]

[*] Fixed Unknown Device die always randomizing into an Epic Die on all levels.
[*] Fixed Renewer Module not adding Recycle Virtue in Reroll Virtue slot when all other slots have a Virtue.
[*] Fixed sentinels not drawing a second die when they are repaired and when they were broken they had a second die.
[/list]

May Astrea bless you 💙 ❤️
- Leonardo Castanho, community manager and lead dev of Astrea

notes.title: Beta Test Reworks and Balancing - v1.1.450
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

Keep going with our beta test for reworks/balancing! 
In this beta patch we focused on reworking/balancing out actions from [b]Hevelius :hevelius: and Austra :austra:[/b].

[b]Important Note: All new actions currently have temporary icons/names and all of the new text is currently only available in English. All of the changes in the beta version are subject to change.[/b]

[b]To access Astrea beta version:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right-click Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles in your Steam Library
[*] Select Properties...
[*] Select the Betas tab
[*] Click the Beta Participation dropdown and select the "beta" branch
[/list]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now pressing "Esc" when inspecting a die, viewing draw pool, discard, dice pool and etc (all UI that player can go back) will go back to previous screen instead of opening the Pause Menu.
[*] Now pressing mouse right-click while dragging a die or a Virtue will drop the current dragged item.
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts for End Turn, Draw Pool, Discard, Dice Pool, Corruption Meter and Hearts, Sentinels and map UI.
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts for selecting Dice and Virtues.
[*] Added key binding menu.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Neutral[/b]
[list]
[*] Buffed Boost, now all enemies receive 10 Purification for each die discarded during the draw phase when Boost is active.
[*] Artisan Staff won't appear on Chapter 1 anymore.
[*] Apprentice's Card won't appear on Chapter 3 anymore.
[/list]
[b]Moonie[/b]
[list]
[*] Moon Shard won't appear on Chapter 1 anymore.
[*] Nerfed Lunar Alignment dice values.
[*] Buffed Ominous Conjuration, now it also draw 1 die.
[*] Buffed Crescent Beam dice values. Changed Risky Die to be a Balanced Die.
[*] Nerfed New Moon Ray dice values.
[/list]
[b]Cellarius[/b]
[list]
[*] Buffed Soothe Mind dice values.
[*] Balanced Tonic Trance, now it deals 2 Purification to a selected enemy for each point of Corruption decreased.
[*] Nerfed Forge Wave dice values.
[*] Balanced Trident of Depths. Now it also replaces your Area Purify 2 Virtue with Enemy Wave 2 Virtue.
[/list]
[b]Hevelius[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked Glowing Reactor, now player can receive Purification normally, but Whenever player receives Corruption dealt by the player itself or sentinel, Light Shield is ignored.
[*] Reworked Battery Prototype, now it applies 1 Link: Boost to a random sentinel instead of Boost.
[*] Buffed Fortify, now also Light Shield is not removed at the start player next X turns. Buffed Fortify dice values. Removed Dissolve Life from Risky Die.

[*] Now Light Shield blocks Corruption before Barrier.
[*] Buffed Field Barrier dice values. Changed Field Barrier Balanced Die to Risky Die.
[*] Buffed Restoration Burst dice values. Removed Risky Die.
[*] Buffed Augmented Welding dice values. Added 1 Draw 1 die face on Safe Die. Added 2 Draw 1 die faces on Balanced Die. Now it doesn't increase sentinel current Corruption when applied, only the Max Corruption.
[*] Buffed Unstable Scrapping, now next time the sentinel that was broken by Unstable Scrapping is Repaired, all the effects that it had before being Broken will be restored. Added an Epic Die.
[*] Buffed Overloaded Repair, now all effects that the Repaired sentinel had before being Broken will be restored. Added an Epic Die.
[*] Buffed Sparkling Repair Balanced Die. Removed Sparkling Repair Risky Die.
[*] Buffed Vile Repair dice values.
[*] Buffed Link: Rock Plate, now it increases Corruption received by the sentinel by only 1.
[*] Buffed Link: Vorpal Plate Safe Die values. Now it doesn't increase Corruption received by the sentinel anymore.
[*] Buffed Link: Empower Safe Die values. Now it doesn't increase Corruption received by the sentinel anymore.
[*] Buffed Link: Boost dice values. Changed Link: Boost Risky Die to Balanced Die. Now it doesn't increase Corruption received by the sentinel anymore. Now all enemies receive 10 Purification for each die discarded during the draw phase when Link: Boost is active.
[*] Lacertian Beam won't appear on Chapter 1 anymore.
[*] Buffed Iron Strike dice values.
[*] Buffed Vorpal Plate Safe Die values. Added Purify 1 to 4 die faces.
[*] Nerfed Incorruptible Aura dice values. Added Unforgeable Corrupt to 2 die faces.
[*] Buffed Auto Turret Safe Die values. Added Purify 1 to 3 die faces.
[*] Defiant Alarm won't appear on Chapter 1 anymore.
[/list]
[b]Austra[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked starting Dice Pool. Added a Minor Aimless, 2 x Random Purify 4, 2 x Random Purify 3, 1 x Random Purify 2, 1 x Random Corrupt 1. Removed a Minor Purify.
[*] Buffed Tempest Pollen, whenever the player or a sentinel deal Purification to a sentinel, a random enemy receives 1 Purification for each Purification received by that sentinel divided by 2 (rounded down) with a minimun of 2.
[*] Buffed Apian Lamp, now it makes Random Purify deal Purification to a random target 2 times.
[*] Buffed Celestial Dew, now it increases Critical Multiplier for each criteria matched. For instance a Random Purify on a Safe Die will increase Critical Multiplier by 4.
[*] Buffed Guiding Chime, increased Wind Glide value from 1 to 2.
[*] Balanced Winged Pinwheel Wind Skitter value from 10 to 4.
[*] Reworked Favorable Winds, now a random enemy receive X Purification whenever player plays a Chaotic++ Die. Favorable Winds can trigger Critical. Added an Epic Die.
[*] Balanced Wind Skitter dice values.
[*] Buffed Wind Glide dice values.
[*] Buffed Invoke Gale, now it create multiple Chaotic++ Die.
[*] Buffed Rising Gust dice values. Added 2 Draw 1 die faces on Safe Die.
[*] Buffed Aerial Needle dice values, added 2 Random Purify die faces.
[*] Reworked Clarity Whirlwind. Now it changes all dice from player hand with Random Purify action into Area Enemy Purify action until the end of enemies turn and changes all dice from player hand with Purify action of any type into Random Purify action until the end of enemies turn. Then it deals X Purification to all enemies for each action affected by this action. Removed Safe Die. Added Epic Die.
[*] Reworked Resonant Buzz, now on the next X Purifications received by the player coming from a Random Purify action, all enemies receive 1 Purification for each Purification received by the player.
[*] Buffed Brilliance dice values. Added 1 Draw 1 die face on Safe Die. Added 2 Draw 1 die faces on Balanced Die. Added Draw 1 to all die faces on Epic Die.
[*] Buffed Dodge Safe Die values, added Purify 1 to 2 die faces.
[*] Dazzling Light won't appear on Chapter 1 anymore.
[*] Dancing Wings won't appear on Chapter 1 anymore.
[*] Thundering Riposte Balanced Die and Risky Die won't appear on Chapter 1 anymore.
[*] Charging Antennas won't appear on Chapter 1 anymore.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed Trident of Depths not increasing Wave from Refreshing Headbutt, Geyser Uppercut and Tidal Jet.
[*] Fixed Aerial Needle removing its own buff from dice affected by Clarity Whirlwind.
[*] Fixed Neutral dice appearing on muted chapters.
[*] Fixed dice appearing on muted chapters when getting the dice from a random interaction (like Invoke, Dicesmith Statue, etc.).
[*] Fixed Defiant Alarm softlocking the game when playing it.
[*] Fixed the word Ruins from Astropolis Ruins being highlighted in yellow when Anomaly 10 is active.
[*] Fixed Voidsmith not activating its Overcorruption action.
[*] Fixed Astrea Second Phase not activating its die when it just changed state.
[*] Fixed Amplify description telling that only dice from hand can be selected when it could be any dice.
[*] Fixed Sun Ray description.
[*] Fixed Ambush battle softlocking on the battle victory screen.
[/list]

May Astrea bless you 💙 ❤️
- Leonardo Castanho, community manager and lead dev of Astrea

notes.title: Bug Fixes - v1.1.42
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

As I mentioned in this post from November 2023.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1755830/view/5849674468181968436]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1755830/view/5849674468181968436[/url] 
I (Leo) ended up getting sick and needed to work on Astrea post release updates slower to take care of my health. 🤒
Because of that, many bug reports ended up piling up. 😭
But I'm feeling better (not 100% though) and I decided to tackle a bunch of those bugs. 💪
So this patch is just a bunch of bug fixes! There are still more bugs to be fixed though, but they will be fixed eventually.

Other than that, we are working on the v1.2, our next Major Update and I hope to have more news to share about it soon.
Here is a screenshot with a little spoiler about the v1.2, can you guess what it will be?
🧐🧐🧐🧐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377658/4dc0c32c9ef976d0d46a5fb8b8c709293f765c65.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now when creating a mod there is no need to add "+" to the die name of Balanced, Risky and Epic versions, the game will automatically do that using the "DieTier" field.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Champion and Mastery achievements not being unlocked after disabling mods if player reached Astrea's Heart and reached Max Level with mods enabled previously.
[*] Fixed Create New Character Die mod not adding ""+"" to the die name internally on Balanced, Risky and Epic versions. This was making the dice appear normally on the compendium, but during the run, the dice with same name, but different tiers, would override each other.
[*] Fixed softlock when Sands of Time triggers Cursed Prediction.
[*] Fixed Apian Drone drawing die outside of player turn.
[*] Fixed Outbreak VFX remaining on the battle forever if the Doom applied by Outbreak was denied by Protection.
[*] Fixed Smoke Bomb not being stackable when it should. Smoke Bomb die was changed from 4 x Smoke Bomb, 2 x Corrupt 1 to 1 x Smoke Bomb 2, 3 x Smoke Bomb 1, 2 x Corrupt 1.
[*] Fixed Deadly Oscillation Action changed by Defiant Alarm being affected by doom.
[*] Fixed Atrocious Decimator and Collapsed Astrea not being affected by start of enemy turn and end of enemy turn effects (like Relief, Decay, etc).
[*] Fixed Forged Auto Turret softlocking the game when the die with it was drawn.
[*] Fixed Prediction Convergence softlocking when there is no die on dice pool or discard.
[*] Fixed Bottled Aurora softlocking the game when player pressed Reroll Hand button with no die on his hand.
[*] Fixed Anomaly Control and Anomaly Master achievements not being unlocked if player win a run on higher anomaly than the achievement requests.
[*] Fixed Heart Fragment sometimes activating Hypersensitive Aura at the start of the battle when Devotion Orb is active.
[*] Fixed Wave Bender achievement not being unlocked in a specific situation.
[*] Fixed Reflexive Mind achievement being unlocked when player moved his orbs during battle if he already had unlocked The World Goes ’Round... achievement.
[*] Fixed Spectral Harvester blinking even when it is not about to trigger.
[*] Fixed Spectral Harvester softlocking when triggered with Shamanic Whispering or Dangerous Excavation with no die on Draw Pool.
[*] Fixed Calm dealing 1 fewer Purification than it was supposed to deal.
[*] Fixed Obscure not hiding Astrea Avatar Overcorruption Meter when she resurrects from her Collapsed Astrea state through Solar Rebirth.
[*] Fixed Blighted Soul not hiding Astrea Avatar Corruption Meter when she resurrects from her Collapsed Astrea state through Solar Rebirth.
[*] Fixed Obscure turning only half of the Overcorruption Meter black.
[*] Fixed Blighted Soul turning only half of the Corruption Meter black.
[*] Fixed Zenith Ring (and any other Blessing) blinking outside of battle.
[*] Fixed Purification preview from dice like New Moon Ray, Bloody Moon Ray++, etc. outside of battle not working correctly.
[*] Fixed derivated dice from Solar Cradle not being shown as discovered on Compendium.
[*] Fixed Hourglass Mastery no triggering when player have no Sands of Time.
[*] Fixed Hourglass Mastery triggering itself when playing it for the first time.
[*] Fixed Inventive counting as two actions and making Anomaly 9 and Crimson Solstice tick twice.
[*] Fixed playing a Copycat from Charged Pylon sentinel on a dice with forged faces making the Charged Pylon die stick with the forged faces forever.
[/list]

May Astrea bless you 💙 ❤️
- Leonardo Castanho, community manager and lead dev of Astrea

notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

I'm happy to announce that we are starting an open beta for Mod Support.
We are looking for beta testers to help creating mods and testing the tools.

We created a system to make mods from JSON (a text file), this way non-programmers can also create mods without previous programming knowledge.
These are the JSON Mods supported right now:
[list]
[*] Create New Character Die
[*] Modify Character, Sentinel and Enemy Dice
[*] Create Starter Dice Sets
[*] Create Virtues Sets
[*] Mute Dice and Blessings

notes.title: Astrea Post Release Development Update
notes.content:
Hey Oracles!
How are you doing? Hope you are having fun with Astrea!

So... I wanted to take a minute to talk about Astrea post release development and why it's been a while that we don't send a new patch.
As I mentioned before we are only two programmers, where one is also working on XBox porting alongside some Astrea's features and the other one (myself) is also the lead game designer and producer of the game, which means that we have a lot to do and if one of us get sick, the development gets slower and guess what? I'm sick...
I've been overworking/crunching in Astrea for about 1 and half years now, working way more than 40hours per week (my notes says 65 hours per week average, with some weeks working 100 hours), skipping many weekends and holidays, trying to make Astrea as polished as possible and with as much content as possible. Maybe I could have slow things down before, I don't know, but I never felt that it was an option, the feeling was that I needed to give everything that I had to it. I guess I knew that it was a lot of work for the size of our team and the amount of time we had and I didn't see other option since I didn't want to make the scope smaller =P
But now this overwork is charging it's price. Since the release of the patch v1.0.197 that made the game much more stable my brain simply melted, I started feeling depressed and I've been struggling to even look at my work station since then. Honestly it was hard to even stay inside my house (I work from home). So I ended up working less than expected on the last weeks. I'm pretty sure I'm having a burnout right now, honestly...
Then this week I started to get a little bit better and decided to work normally and guess what? I started having a lot of pain in my back, I had to go to the emergency because of the pain. Now I can't sit or stand for too long or my back hurts a lot.
With all that said, I will need to slow things down and take care of my health (mental and physical). I'm not trying to make anyone pity of me or anything I'm just trying to be honest and open. I don't want anyone thinking that we abandoned the game or anything.
We will keep working on Astrea, we want to bring more content, more QoL, bug fixes and balancing, but in a slower pace.
I will take 1 week vacation now, will be back on November 27th. Other team members will be around in case you need help or have any questions.
And I will take another vacation at the end of the year (this time the whole team actually).

[h2]Astrea Post Release Development Update[/h2]
Now update about the development itself, these are our higher priorities.

[h3]Controller Support Improvements[/h3]
Inoue (the other programmer) has been working on XBox porting, but also he is improving the controller support.
The first thing he is working on and I think the most important one is the controller selection highlight, now there will be a highlight showing where the controller current selection is, here are three screenshots on how it is looking at the moment:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377658/fd42d967f1e1b84c9ced9187ba3383cbde995c6f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377658/6862d2cd15951f44890596835b4bf600f461ffc3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377658/ab9ba5fae507e1927c6eb826a3c829919370d8bf.png[/img]

We also plan to make the input for leaving the shop, confirming rewards/shop items and skipping rewards easier/faster.
Also will add support for looking your hand when using Astral Calling, Void Seek, Bottled Aurora, etc.

Will try sending a new patch with the controller improvement in 2/3 weeks.

[h3]Daily Runs[/h3]
I started working on Daily Runs! The first draft of Game Design is done and now I started programming it, I got sick in the middle of the process of the programming the Daily Runs sadly. But when I get better I will get back to work on it and when it is ready I will send a patch into the beta branch to be playtested by players =D

[h3]Balancing and Bug Fixing[/h3]
This is a topic that I will keep working on it! There are some minor reworks (One or another action, effect, blessing) that I want to rework that were suggested by the community.
Examples of Balancing and Reworks: 
- Change Stunned to let player Reroll only 1 die and then decrease Stunned by 1.
- Corrupted Moonie is too strong when compared to other Corrupted Oracles. I will nerf her.
- Moonite starter kit need to be stronger. I will buff it.

Reworks will pass through the beta branch as well. Probably I'm sending the reworks on next beta branch patch and before the Daily Run.

[h3]QoL: Damage Projection[/h3]
This is one of the most requested features and we will implement it eventually. Sadly it is not an easy task. So it will take a while, but it is one of our priorities. But we felt that improving the controllers and adding Daily Runs were more important, but after these topics we will tackle the Damage Projection.

Thanks for all your support and kind words. They are very heart warming and give us strength to keep working in the game.

May Astrea bless you 💙 ❤️
- Leonardo Castanho, community manager and lead dev of Astrea

notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

Due to complains about higher anomalies being too harsh/unfair on Chapter 1 (Tainted Reef) here is a new balancing patch with some nerfs to Anomaly 8 Chapter 1 enemies and a nerf to Anomaly 10.

Please feel free to share your feedback about those changes.
Hope this will make the gameplay experience better.
But if it doesn't we are open to make changes and keep improving the higher anomalies balancing.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Anomaly Levels[/b]
[list]
[*] Anomaly Level 10 nerfed now it applies Ruin every 2 turns and the amount of Ruin applied is based on the Chapter. Tainted Reef 1/ Astropolis Ruins 2/ Ground Zero 2.
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Deformed Sluggian and Crystal Tainted Reef Normal Battle rebalanced. Nerfed Anomaly 3, decreased Crystallized Swirl Over Corruption action Player Corrupt from 4 to 2. Rebalanced Anomaly 8, decreased Crystallized Swirl Over Corruption action Player Corrupt from 4 to 2 and changed die face Self Corrupt 6 to Selft Corrupt 6 + Player Shadow Mantle 2. Deformed Sluggian increased 1 die face Player Corrupt 3 to 4.
[*] Crashed Sentinel Tainted Reef Normal Battle Anomaly 8 rebalanced, removed starting Decay. Changed Area Corrupt die faces to Player Corrupt 2 + Self Corrupt 4 to 6.
[*] Prismatic Nettle Tainted Reef Normal Battle Anomaly 3 and 8 rebalanced, decreased Over Corruption action Player Corrupt from 4 to 3. Anomaly 8 Increased 1 die face Player Corrupt 3 + Enemy Self Corrupt 2 to Player Corrupt 3 + Enemy Self Corrupt 3
[*] Lost Sentinel Tainted Reef Normal Battle Anomaly 8 nerfed, decreased Over Corruption action Player Corrupt from 4 to 2. Decreased die face Player Corrupt 3 to Player Corrupt 2. Increased die face Player Corrupt 1 to Player Corrupt 2.
[*] Devonian Celacanto Tainted Reef Normal Battle Anomaly 8 nerfed, increased Over Corruption from 4 to 6.
[*] Blind Dunkleosteus and Jaw Dunkleosteus Tainted Reef Normal Battle Anomaly 8 nerfed, Blind Dunkleosteus decreased die face Player Corrupt 3 - Player Doom 2 to Player Corrupt 2 - Doom 2 and increased Over Corruption from 4 to 5. Jaw Dunkleosteus increased Over Corruption from 5 to 7.
[*] Cursed Shell and Prismatic Stinger Tainted Reef Normal Battle Anomaly 3 and 8 nerfed, increased Cursed Shell Over Corruption from 5 to 7.
[*] Tormeted Seer Ground Zero Normal Battle Anomaly 0 nerfed, increased Over Corruption from 7 to 9.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed new save file backup system.
[*] Fixed Sentinel selection menu gets out of sync and fails to show dice.
[*] Fixed Softlock when player use Manipulate virtue and didn't has a available dice on hand using joystick.
[/list]

May Astrea bless you 💙 ❤️
- Leonardo Castanho, community manager and lead dev of Astrea

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Minor Improvements - v1.0.59
notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

Thanks for the patience for this patch with many bug fixes.
Not all bugs reported are fixed in this patch, but we fixed as many as we could on a short period of time and we focused on the worst ones (of course 🤣).

Also we made the changes requested to the Anomaly Level and Astrea Level unlocking system.

So we preferred sending this patch now even though not all bugs are fixed.

We will keep working on bug fixing and improvements 💪

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now Anomaly Level and Astrea Level are shared between all oracles. But to have access to Anomaly Level with a specific Oracle, player need to win at least one run with the oracle.
[*] Changed Corrupt enemy blessing description from "Whenever you or a sentinel deal Corruption to an enemy with at least X Corruption," to "Whenever you or a sentinel deal at least X Corruption to an enemy," to make it more clear that is the Corruption dealt and not the 
enemy's current Corruption.
[*] Removed "New Run!" button from run victory screen.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Neutral[/b]
[list]
[*] Altar Of Fractals event no longer appears on Chapter 1.
[/list]
[b]Hevelius[/b]
[list]
[*] Static Alternator buffed, increase Charged Body gain from 1 to 3 Charged Body for each 2 Safe Die on player dice pool.

[/list]

notes.content:
Hey Oracles,

First off, thank you for the amazing support with the launch of [i]Astrea[/i]!
We couldn’t be happier seeing all the people who are enjoying the launch, all the kind words.
It is an amazing feeling! Thanks for the support!
🎉😭🎉💪🎉😭🎉

We have received feedback from the community that there are a few issues with some localization. Incorrect translations currently read  “every x turns, do y” only say “every turn, do y”, without the turn number (and some other action descriptions) which this patch addresses.

This patch also fixes some of the bugs already reported, but we couldn’t fix all of them yet, because it was important to send this localization patch as soon as possible, but we will keep working on the rest of them. We are also trying to make some balance changes based on your feedback, some of those changes will probably be on the next patch already (not this one, but the next xD).

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

notes.title: Balance Updates to Forge Action Patch Notes (0.45.584)
notes.content:
Hey, Oracles!

We’ve been hard at work preparing for the launch of [i]Astrea[/i] next week on September 21st! Before launching the game we wanted to give the demo one final patch before launch to improve player experience. These changes will be part of the full game!

[b][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][/b]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Demo save will be wiped on this patch!
[*] Minor UI Improvements
[*] Changed mouse/controller detection on main menu and intro cutscene to be dynamic, which means that player doesn't need to go to settings to change it anymore
[*] Better support for steam deck (now it automatically comes with a controller layout)
[*] Added Korean and Traditional Chinese languages
[*] Now the game asks if you allow the game to collect your gameplay data for balancing purposes on the first time you play.
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
[h3]Settings Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Accessibility tab changed to Miscellaneous tab
[*] Credits moved from Main Menu to Misc tab
[*] Delete save moved from Gameplay tab to Misc tab
[*] Added the option to stop data collection (analytics data)
[*] Now player can go back to the shop after leaving the shop
[*] The game now runs in the background if you click outside of the game.
[*] Now prices on shop are tinted in red when player don't have enough star shards.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Tutorial Improvements
[*]  New actions added to the game: Unforgeable actions, those actions work like other actions, but they can't be forged.
[*]  Now Duplicating a die on forge will increase the cost by 50.
[*]  Balanced Forge Actions. Some actions got higher price, but we still have 3 price tiers 100, 150, 200. Also added more actions. And now it will always appear 3 x 200 cost actions, 1 x 150 and 1 x 100.
[*]  Inventive reworked, now it deals 3 Purification X times, where X is the amount of die discarded.
[/list]
Ten days until the launch of Astrea! If you love the demo, be sure to wishlist Astrea!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755830/Astrea_SixSided_Oracles/ 

Hope you are getting your dice ready!
-riv otter
